answer.reason: The verses tell of several major deeds and events of Satan that a reader would name him for.

clauses.english: was permitted by the LORD to afflict Job, and smote him with sore boils
clauses.quote: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils

clauses.english: tempted Jesus in the wilderness and was told to get behind him
clauses.quote: Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written

clauses.english: entered into Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus
clauses.quote: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot

clauses.english: was cast out of heaven to the earth after war with Michael and his angels
clauses.quote: the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan

doubts: The Revelation verses about the dragon are taken as speaking of Satan because REV 12:9 names him.
Beelzebub and the beast verses were left out as not stating a deed of Satan himself.
The future events of REV 20 (binding, loosing, the lake of fire) were left out to keep the line short.
